name: Auth Your Agent
description: Reviews the tools that drive a signed-in browser vault: navigate, click, type_text, fill_secret (types a saved password or TOTP code the agent never sees) and request_approval. Reads, status checks, take over and sign-out stay unattended. The server also holds committing clicks for phone approval. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep fill_secret on Review: it types a stored password or authenticator code into the page, even though the agent never sees the value.
The vault already holds every committing click, Enter and scripted write for phone approval; Review on click adds a second prompt for routine clicks.
end_session stays on Allow because it signs out and wipes the browser profile; pausing it would leave the owner signed in after the agent stops.
